parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, typically circular and flat for easy pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is pressed by the user to activate the pump mechanism, dispensing liquid soap or lotion from the container.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head includes the pump nozzle and connecting structure, made of durable plastic, attached to the lid and base body.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the base body through the pump and out of the nozzle when the lid is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but allows internal fluid movement through the pump mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of polyethylene plastic, typically cylindrical or rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid soap or lotion and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the reservoir for the liquid.
